environment.label: CoRTAD Version 6 (temperature values in the survey data)
environment.citation: Saha, K., et al. (2018). The Coral Reef Temperature Anomaly Database (CoRTAD) Version 6. NOAA NCEI.
environment.definitions: SSTA = weekly SST minus weekly climatological SST (degrees C). TSA_DHW = sum of the previous 12 weeks when TSA >= 1 degree C, where TSA = weekly SST minus the maximum weekly climatological SST.
